RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 50

An all-male panel paired with subjective criteria favoring a candidate with lesser formal qualifications suggests potential affinity or unconscious bias. However, other valid factors—such as interview performance, local government relationships, or leadership style—could legitimately explain the outcome.

Raising gender bias immediately without documentation risks burning professional bridges. Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your scoring matrix and written feedback. If the municipality continues to stonewall or the evaluation rubric shows clear inconsistencies, consider submitting a public records request or consulting an employment lawyer to assess whether filing a formal grievance is warranted.
